runs.text: This program computes in two tasks the double and the triple of a number and shows the sum. With 0 it is right. Find a number it gets wrong.

hints.text: When is the sum shown, and when is the triple awaited?
The sum uses a provisional value instead of the result of the second task.
That provisional value is 0: the program is only right when the triple is also 0.
With 4 it shows 8 instead of 20. Close with the variant.

runs.text: Which line has to be moved for the program to be right?
Any number other than 0 breaks it. It is the error of using a result before awaiting it: the provisional value hides the missing wait.
